name: Swaddle
overview: The concept of swaddling in Scripture conveys care, protection, and preparation, particularly evident in the context of children. Luke 2:7 and 2:12 highlight the humble yet purposeful wrapping of the Christ child in swaddling clothes, signifying both His humanity and divine purpose. In Job 38:9, swaddling imagery extends metaphorically to God's sovereign control over creation, while Ezekiel 16:4 and Lamentations 2:22 use the term to reflect nurturing and upbringing, emphasizing the vulnerability and dependence of those swaddled. Together, these verses illustrate swaddling as a symbol of God's providential care and the tender beginnings of life under His watchful hand.
